@RachakondaCop issues 
Traffic Advisory – Messi tour, #Uppal

In view of the MESSI Tour & Live Event at Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium, Uppal on 13.12.2025, moderate traffic congestion is expected. Traffic diversions will be in effect within the limits of Uppal Traffic PS.

🔸 Heavy Vehicles Diversion:
Lorries, Dumpers, Earth Movers, Water Tankers, RMC Trucks & all other heavy vehicles will be diverted.

🔸 Diversion Timings:
 13th December 2025 — 12:00 hrs to 23:50 hrs

🔸 Expected Congestion:

⏱️ 14:00 hrs to 23:50 hrs

Routes likely to be congested:
#Falaknuma → #Santoshnagar → Uppal

#Secunderabad → #Habsiguda → Uppal
